help:
Inspect one collected function entry


facts-tool analyse call-graph-entry [OPTIONS]


OPTIONS:
  -h,     --help              Print this help message and exit
  -v,     --verbose LEVEL:INT in [0 - 3] [1]  
                              Verbosity level: 0=quiet, 1=stages, 2=details, 3=trace; defaults
                              to 1 when omitted
  -f,     --facts FILE REQUIRED 
                              SQLite facts database
  -c,     --conf FILE         Direct project DB: overrides FACTS_TOOL_CONF and generated
                              naming/ownership; compiler extras use YAML when CLI --extra-arg
                              is omitted
          --config FILE       YAML defaults (yaml-cpp 0.9.0); every explicitly supplied CLI
                              value overrides its YAML value, while omitted CLI values fall
                              back. Files merge per key, highest precedence first:
                              --config/FACTS_TOOL_CONFIG file, the nearest project
                              .facts-tool.yaml, then the user file at
                              XDG_CONFIG_HOME/facts-tool/config.yaml or
                              HOME/.config/facts-tool/config.yaml; explicit --extra-arg
                              occurrences override matching compiler options and retain
                              unrelated YAML defaults, without rewriting YAML files. Without
                              CLI extras, YAML tokens concatenate user, then project, then
                              selected file. Built-ins: XDG_DATA_HOME/facts-tool or
                              HOME/.local/share/facts-tool,
                              conf_template={relative_path}/{filename}.db, and extra_args=[].
                              Placeholders in conf_template/facts_template: {project_root},
                              {project_name}, {relative_path}, {filename}, {user}, and
                              ${ENV_NAME}. facts_template supplies --output/-o, --facts/-f when
                              omitted. Use config show for per-key provenance without mutation.
          --function SELECTOR REQUIRED 
                              Qualified function name or USR
          --format FORMAT:{text,json} 
                              Output representation: text or json
